question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Greets**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Greets **means to welcome or acknowledge someone with a friendly gesture or words. (**अभिवादन करना**)

 
 
• **Example**: *When they entered the room, the host warmly greeted each guest with a smile and a handshake.*
 
 
 
• The word "**greets**" is appropriate because it conveys a positive and friendly action.
 
• When someone turns and greets another person, it implies a warm welcome or acknowledgement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Opts: **Chooses or selects from available options. (**चुनना**)
 
• **Discreet: **Showing good judgment and maintaining privacy. (**विचारशील**)
 
• **Rejects: **Refuses or declines something. (**अस्वीकृत**)
